checklist.done: a monthly filing status report is presented to the Compliance Committee with any at-risk filing highlighted and minuted.

testing.step: Build the population of filings submitted in the quarter
actions: Independently export from SERFF Filing Access every filing with a submission date in the test quarter, by state and product.
Reconcile the export to the filing tracker's population for the same period.
Resolve any count or tracking-number difference before sampling.
testing.done: the SERFF-pulled population reconciles to the filing tracker for the quarter.

testing.step: Recompute the latest submission date and compare to actual submission
actions: For every filing in the population, independently recompute the latest submission date from the target effective date and the state's deemer/lead-time rules.
Compare to the actual SERFF submission date.
List every filing submitted after its recomputed latest submission date as an automatic exception.
testing.done: the recomputed latest submission date is compared to actual submission for every filing, with late filings listed.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of filings flagged late in the recomputation step.
Take 15 rows selected at random (seeded, reproducible) from the remaining on-time population, minimum 25 rows total.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample is drawn, reproducible and includes every late filing.

testing.step: Trace each sampled filing's status history in SERFF
actions: Open SERFF Filing Access for each sampled SERFF Tracking Number and pull the full status history.
Compare the status history to the filing tracker's recorded status changes and dates.
Log any discrepancy in status or date as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled filing's SERFF status history is compared to the tracker with discrepancies logged.

testing.step: Verify objection handling on the sample
actions: For each sampled filing that received an objection, confirm the objection was handed off the same day it was received per the tracker timestamp.
Confirm the C16 objection-response process record exists and references this filing's SERFF Tracking Number.
Log any missing or late hand-off as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled objection is confirmed same-day handed off with a linked response record, or is logged as an exception.

testing.step: Verify satisfied-deemer documentation on the sample
actions: For each sampled filing closed on a satisfied-deemer basis, confirm a dated screenshot and documented conclusion exist.
Independently recompute the deemer date and confirm it had genuinely passed with no objection before the conclusion was drawn.
Log any premature or unsupported satisfied-deemer conclusion as an exception.
testing.done: every sampled satisfied-deemer conclusion is independently confirmed accurate or logged as an exception.

testing.step: Confirm the release gate held until approval or satisfied deemer
actions: For each sampled filing, pull the earliest-use date actually configured in the policy admin/rating system for that state.
Compare the configured earliest-use date to the SERFF approval date or the satisfied-deemer date.
Treat any use configured before approval or a satisfied deemer as a reportable compliance breach, not a test exception.
testing.done: no sampled state was configured for use before approval or a satisfied deemer.

testing.step: Verify retention filing for the sample
actions: Confirm the compliance evidence repository holds the submission confirmation, correspondence and disposition letter for each sampled filing.
Confirm the 7-year retention label is applied.
Log any missing evidence as an exception.
testing.done: retention evidence is confirmed complete and correctly labelled for every sampled filing.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the SERFF Tracking Number, what was missed and the compliance impact.
Assign a root cause (late submission, missed objection, unsupported deemer claim, premature release) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and, for use-before-approval breaches, open a self-report assessment with Regulatory Counsel.
Carry every open exception into the next quarter's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, root cause, owner, remediation date and retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate and compare to the zero-late-submission/zero-premature-use threshold.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have the independent reviewer, who submitted or tracked none of the sampled filings, sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Compliance Committee and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion and exception rate exists in the repository, reported to the Compliance Committee.
